notes: The source page is the MiraCosta College General Education (MCGE) pattern (Plan A), not the Social Justice Studies: Chicana and Chicano Studies A.A-T program page. It contains no requirements, totals, outcomes or careers for this award, so no blocks were recorded.
GE courses never go in a block; closed-list courses that appear in the GE areas were listed in missing_explained.
The MCGE page itself states it is not intended for students transferring to a four-year institution; an A.A-T would normally use Cal-GETC or CSU GE, which this text does not name for the award.
Reviewer should locate the program's own catalog page (e.g., under Social Justice Studies) to record its requirements.
